ops.name: Add
ops.summary: Adds. Stacks linearly, so ten copies are ten times the effect.

ops.name: Multiply
ops.summary: Multiplies. Stacks geometrically - two copies of 1.6x is 2.56x, not 3.2x.

ops.name: Set
ops.summary: Overrides outright. Extra copies do nothing, because the last one applied wins.

stats.name: MoveSpeed
stats.label: Move speed
stats.blurb: Top speed you can reach running under your own power.

stats.name: Acceleration
stats.label: Acceleration
stats.blurb: How hard you push toward top speed while on the ground.

stats.name: AirControl
stats.label: Air control
stats.blurb: The fraction of your ground acceleration that still works in mid-air.

stats.name: TurnBoost
stats.label: Turn boost
stats.blurb: Extra acceleration when you steer against your own momentum, so speed does not feel like ice.

stats.name: GroundFriction
stats.label: Ground friction
stats.blurb: How fast the ground bleeds off speed above your top speed. Stops you quickly and takes momentum away.

stats.name: AirDrag
stats.label: Air drag
stats.blurb: How fast the air bleeds off speed. Low drag is what keeps a launch worth having.

stats.name: JumpSpeed
stats.label: Jump speed
stats.blurb: How fast you leave the ground, and therefore how high you get.

stats.name: GravityScale
stats.label: Gravity
stats.blurb: Multiplier on the gravity that pulls you down.

stats.name: Radius
stats.label: Body size
stats.blurb: How big you are. Bigger is easier to hit and harder to fit through gaps.

stats.name: ExtraJumps
stats.label: Extra jumps
stats.blurb: Jumps you get in mid-air before touching the ground again.

stats.name: BlinkCharges
stats.label: Blink charges
stats.blurb: How many blinks you hold at once.

stats.name: BlinkSpeed
stats.label: Blink speed
stats.blurb: How fast a blink throws you, which is how far it takes you.

stats.name: BlinkCooldown
stats.label: Blink cooldown
stats.blurb: Wait before a spent blink comes back.

stats.name: WallSlideSpeed
stats.label: Wall slide speed
stats.blurb: How fast you slide down a wall once the cling has run out.

stats.name: WallKickSpeed
stats.label: Wall kick speed
stats.blurb: The shove away from a wall when you jump off it.

stats.name: WallClingTime
stats.label: Wall cling time
stats.blurb: How long you stay stuck to a wall before gravity takes over.

stats.name: WallClimbSpeed
stats.label: Wall climb speed
stats.blurb: How fast you go up a wall while clinging and pressing into it.

stats.name: BlockWindow
stats.label: Block window
stats.blurb: How long a block stays live after you press it. This is the size of the read.

stats.name: BlockCooldown
stats.label: Block cooldown
stats.blurb: Wait before you can block again, measured from the press.

stats.name: BlockReflectScale
stats.label: Reflect speed
stats.blurb: Speed multiplier on a shot you deflect back at whoever sent it.

stats.name: MaxHealth
stats.label: Max health
stats.blurb: How much damage you can absorb before dying.

stats.name: Regeneration
stats.label: Regeneration
stats.blurb: Health that comes back on its own, every second.

stats.name: LifeSteal
stats.label: Life steal
stats.blurb: The fraction of damage you deal that comes back to you as health.

stats.name: DamageTakenScale
stats.label: Damage taken
stats.blurb: Multiplier on every point of damage that reaches you.

stats.name: SelfDamageScale
stats.label: Self damage
stats.blurb: Multiplier on damage you do to yourself, with your own bounces and blasts.

stats.name: BoundsBounceDamage
stats.label: Out-of-bounds damage
stats.blurb: Flat health lost when the arena throws you back in.

stats.name: BoundsBounceSpeed
stats.label: Out-of-bounds throw
stats.blurb: How hard the arena throws you back in. It is a repositioning either way.

stats.name: Damage
stats.label: Damage
stats.blurb: Health removed by one bullet that lands.

stats.name: BulletSpeed
stats.label: Bullet speed
stats.blurb: How fast a bullet travels, and therefore how much lead a target needs.

stats.name: BulletGravityScale
stats.label: Bullet drop
stats.blurb: How much gravity pulls on a bullet in flight. Zero flies flat.

stats.name: BulletRadius
stats.label: Bullet size
stats.blurb: How fat a bullet is, which is how forgiving a near miss becomes.

stats.name: BulletLifetime
stats.label: Bullet lifetime
stats.blurb: How long a bullet lives before it gives up, which sets its range.

stats.name: ReloadTime
stats.label: Reload time
stats.blurb: How long you spend getting the magazine back.

stats.name: AttackCooldown
stats.label: Attack cooldown
stats.blurb: The gap between shots. Smaller is a faster gun.

stats.name: Spread
stats.label: Spread
stats.blurb: Half-angle of the cone a shot can come out in.

stats.name: Recoil
stats.label: Recoil
stats.blurb: The shove firing gives you. A cost most of the time and a movement tool occasionally.

stats.name: Knockback
stats.label: Knockback
stats.blurb: The shove a landed bullet gives whoever it hit.

stats.name: MagazineSize
stats.label: Magazine size
stats.blurb: Shots before you have to reload.

stats.name: BulletsPerShot
stats.label: Bullets per shot
stats.blurb: How many projectiles leave the barrel per trigger pull.

stats.name: Bounces
stats.label: Bounces
stats.blurb: How many times a bullet comes off the world before it dies. Yours can come back at you.

stats.name: BlastRadius
stats.label: Blast radius
stats.blurb: How far a bullet's explosion reaches. Zero is no explosion at all.

stats.name: ImpactDamageSpeed
stats.label: Impact threshold
stats.blurb: How fast you have to meet a surface before it hurts. Below this, terrain is scenery.

stats.name: ImpactDamageScale
stats.label: Impact damage
stats.blurb: Damage per unit of speed above the impact threshold.

stats.name: ThrusterForce
stats.label: Thruster force
stats.blurb: Acceleration a landed shot attaches to whatever it hit. Zero on a stock gun.

stats.name: ThrusterTime
stats.label: Thruster burn
stats.blurb: How long an attached thruster keeps pushing.
